description: Use this only when you already have a Whale Coupons store slug from an earlier result (the "slug" field, e.g. "airwheel-luggage") and need that store's full coupon details again. Returns the code, discount, how to apply it, minimum order if any, affiliate shop link and store page. For a store name, domain or URL use find_coupons instead.

slug.description: Store slug exactly as returned in a previous result, e.g. "airwheel-luggage".

name: get_store

shop_link.description: Affiliate link to the store (opens the store with the discount).

title: Get one store's coupon details
